data.description: Laya (Convai Innovations, open weights, Apache-2.0): a non-autoregressive System One decision model, the open alternative to TypeSafe Jev. data.name: Tencent Hy-Image-3.5 Preview
data.description: Tencent Hunyuan Hy-Image-3.5 (preview) text-to-image with reference images and multi-turn editing, billed per generated image at the price of its size tier: 1K/2K (output area up to 2048x2048) or 4K (above). Synchronous: POST /v1/images/generations; one image per request (`n` must be 1). Up to 20 reference images in `image` or `images` (a string or an array of HTTP or `data:image/...` URLs). Multi-turn: send the previous response's `assembled_history` as `messages` with the new instruction as `prompt`, and the same `session` string on every turn; each response returns the next `assembled_history`. `size` is `<width>x<height>`, at most 4096x4096 in area (e.g. 2048x2048, or 4096x4096 at the 4K price); omitted, `generate_max_pixels` picks the area (1048576, 2359296 or 4194304; default 2359296). Optional: `seed` (integer), `resize_max_pixels` (area cap for reference images), `footnote` (watermark text, up to 16 characters), `use_search_tool` (true: let the model search the web).

data.name: ByteDance Seedream 4.5
data.description: ByteDance Seedream 4.5 text-to-image with reference images, billed per generated image. One image per request (a larger `n` is refused with 400). `size` is `<width>x<height>` with each side up to 4096 and at least 3,686,400 pixels in total (e.g. 2048x2048 or 2560x1440; 1024x1024 is refused); omitted, the model renders 2048x2048. Up to 14 reference images in `image` (a string or an array of publicly reachable HTTP or `data:image/...` URLs).

data.name: Step 5 Preview
data.description: StepFun Step 5 Preview, a 600B sparse-MoE (27B active) model built for agentic coding, software engineering and finance tasks. Text + image in / text out, 1M context. Thinking is always on and cannot be disabled; the trace is returned in reasoning_content and its tokens are billed inside completion_tokens, so max_tokens must cover thinking plus the answer. Function calling, JSON mode and implicit prompt caching supported.

data.name: Vela 2.0 9B
data.description: Vela 2.0 9B (vllm-sr, open weights, Apache-2.0): a System One decision model for routing and guardrails, with Jev's request and response shape (POST /decisions: model/state/questions). Answers noul / choice / score questions with calibrated probabilities instead of text, plus set questions (every label above threshold) and span questions (labelled character offsets into the state, e.g. personal information or claims a supplied source does not support). Qwen3.5-based decoder (7.9B), 16,384-token input. Billed on input tokens only.
